verdict.rationale: Docs describe Logfire observability as 'built-in (but optional)' — telemetry/tracing is only sent if the logfire package is installed and instrumentation explicitly enabled, implying no tracking happens by default, which functionally satisfies a privacy-conscious user. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated telemetry opt-out flag/setting or a privacy policy addressing usage-data collection outside of Logfire tracing. Missing for 10: explicit opt-out mechanism/setting documentation, statement on any non-Logfire usage analytics, independent confirmation that no data is sent without opt-in.
